تستضعفون (form X)
# تَسْتَضْعِفُونَ (tastaḍʕifūna) /tas.tadˤ.ʕi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# تُسْتَضْعَفُونَ (tustaḍʕafūna) /tus.tadˤ.ʕa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
